description: Real road traffic network data is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors zhang zhonghan. This dataset investigates the effectiveness of various path planning algorithms in urban contexts using real-world traffic networks obtained from OpenStreetMap (OSM) at three different locations: Chongqing, China, Hubei Province, China, and Washington, D.C., USA. OSM data contains complex details of the road network, including road types, traffic restrictions, and geographic features. Coverage: several countries (CN, US); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
